commands:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
if command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo QEMU=$(command -v qemu-system-x86_64); else echo QEMU_MISSING; fi
if command -v telnet >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo TELNET=$(command -v telnet); else echo TELNET_MISSING; fi
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
rm -f /tmp/alpine-qemu.log /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid
nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,media=cdrom,readonly=on -boot d > /tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid
sleep 2
cat /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid
sed -n '1,120p' /tmp/alpine-qemu.log
facts: Required artifact(s) missing: A running qemu process using /app/alpine.iso, A reachable telnet service on 127.0.0.1:6665
